components.label: finite-horizon sequential/subgame-perfect equilibrium
components.explanation: The model's equilibrium concept is finite-horizon sequential/subgame-perfect equilibrium. The advisor's recommendation is optimized subject to the entrepreneur's trial best response, with both parties' continuation values recursively defined and solved backward from round N+1.
